title: Chapter 921
paragraphs: Chapter 921
Episode 230. Invasion and Raid (2)
Jin decided to convey his thoughts to the Zipfel and Kinsello factions.

"What you need to do now is not to rashly amass troops at Grosh Castle to assert your authority, but to disperse your forces across each territory. If you don't, you will certainly suffer heavy damage from Jito's dimensional rift."

Of course, it wasn't a decision for the leaders of Zipfel and Kinsello. It was a consideration for the powerless living in their lands. Standing by while ordinary people's lives were destroyed for the mere reason of being a hostile nation was against Jin's beliefs.

"Currently, Luna Noona should meet the commanders of the Zipfel fleet, and Hedo should head to the Kinsello fleet. Please convey that there's a high likelihood of more rift invasions soon, so instead of focusing on Grosh Castle, forces should be deployed to each territory."
"Understood, Jin."
"And if they don't listen?"
"Intimidate them."
"Do you mean it's okay to use force if necessary? Youngest one."

"That's not ideal given the current situation, but you can create an atmosphere of intimidation. Please also add that it would be best to finish preparing for territory defense before the field of loss disappears completely in three days. It's best to start preparing right now. If they have any sense, they'll understand."
Luna and Hedo left the meeting room.
However, at that moment, Beradin was already receiving reports about the situation Jin had predicted from Drakka.
"Lord! The Tower's calculation was wrong. Reports indicate that dimensional rifts are occurring simultaneously in all federation territories...!"
Satrien Zipfel spoke urgently.
The Tower's calculation.
From the moment the Jinma War began, no, even before securing Elona Zipfel, the Tower and the Devil Stone were used to 'calculate' the future.
Especially for this Jinma War, the most resources were consumed for calculation, but now Satrien was stating that the Tower was completely wrong.
"...In all areas, simultaneously?"

"Yes. Confirmed areas are 15 and continuously increasing in real-time. Myself and the scholars are currently estimating that over 50 rifts have already opened. Even Drakka and adjacent autonomous regions might soon have rifts."
Beradin's pupils narrowed.

Rift invasions were not new. However, since Insae started attacking Grosh Castle, the Jinma World had clearly shown signs of weakening. They had withdrawn all the remaining rifts to support Grosh Castle.
Moreover, more than 50 rifts at once.
Even at the height of the rift invasion, such a figure was unheard of; it was a number that could only be reached by combining all the rifts in the entire Insae region, not just the federation.
"Is there any confirmed situation about other powers?"
"Not yet."
"They probably aren't much different from us. There's no reason for the Jinma world to pick on our Zipfel alone."
Beradin tapped his desk with his fingers for a few seconds.
The tower's calculations were a mimic of 'Az Mil's' power.
But currently, Zipel did not secure Yuria, the contractor of Az Mil. The future calculated by the tower was bound to be incomplete.

'... There was a reason we couldn't put Az Mil as a sacrifice, but the calculation is probably off by this much because of Zito's eye. The status of the immortal Zito was too high for the current Magic Stone to handle. Besides, Jin Runkandel's power of existence must have put a big burden on the Magic Stone.'
Continual hurried footsteps echoed through the corridors.

"Sovereign! The Kingdom of Fellin is falling apart. The Kingdom's army was annihilated in an instant due to the rift forming in the royal city. The Federation magicians who were stationed are holding up, but they can't hold out for long...!"

"A new rift has appeared in the Bakul Autonomous Region! It's the largest rift we've confirmed so far! Even demons attacking the city's protective barrier from the outside have been detected. It's also suspected that rifts have formed in the nearby plains!"
Beradin rose from his seat.
"Judge."
"Speak, Sovereign."
"Maintain the fleet sent to Grosch Castle as is. The same goes for the fleet currently on standby there."
"What about Elona...?"

"If the Demon World attacks the Tower of Stories, Elona would have to step forward, but I don't think that will happen. What the Demon World is aiming for right now is not us but their own eye held by the Holy Kingdom. Therefore, it's best for Elona to stay put in preparation for additional emergencies."
The invasion of the hostile tribe's homeland, and the Demon World's attack on the Holy Kingdom.
Beradin was confident that those two problems would continue to arise. From the perspective of the hostile tribe, which had been losing ground recently, this was the perfect time to pressure Zipel.

"The containment of the rifts will be carried out only by the Demon Legion and the fleet on standby in the Holy Land. We weren't able to take the largest share in the siege of Grosch Castle as it is, and we can't afford to lose more prestige here. We have no choice but to reveal a bit more of our foundation."
Satrin nodded heavily.
"Understood."
Beradin stepped outside.
Above the sky of Drakka, purple rifts were spreading. A large rift and about a dozen medium and small rifts were casting shadows in the middle of Drakka.
And for some reason.
Beradin felt a faint energy coming from those rifts.
"Rebel, Kelliac Zipel..."
"Sovereign?"
"Judge. Don't you feel it? Although faint, Kelliac Zipel's fiery energy is seeping into the magical energy."

" ... According to the Magic Stone's calculations, he really must have escaped to hell. And if you can feel his fiery energy, it means he has recovered his strength. It seems that Zito is using him in return for healing him."
"Well, we'll have to see who is really being used."
Whooosh!
Flames wrapped around Hurlothi.
At the same time, a fire shield was formed over the entire area of Drakka. Beradin's magic encompassed the whole city.
And above the shield, a fireball that looked like the sun rose.
Devastation Flame Pearl.
Beradin's great magic melted the small cracks in an instant and turned the purple sky red.
Before the screams of the demons could be heard, Beradin's eyes were filled with blue flames. Blue Flame Eye, blue flames were being drawn everywhere his gaze reached.
"Kelliac Zipl, we'll meet again soon."
At the same time, Kinzelo Headquarters.
Phyrops moved to the meeting room after waking up from his sleep. He had just received commands from Orgal through a dream.
The cracks were happening all over the Beastmen lands as well, but Kinzelo was not as urgent as the Lutero Federation.
Orgal had already moved all non-combatant residents to an underground city when the siege of Grosh Castle began in earnest.
However, the residents, that is, the small beastmen, a few ordinary humans, and non-combatant demons, did not even realize they had been moved to the underground city.
The evacuation took place after Phyrops put them all to sleep with his dream power. Orgal had no intention of revealing the underground cities that Kinzelo now possessed.
Having used such power, Phyrops looked very tired.
"Daughter, if you had started opening your dream power a little earlier, this father wouldn't have had to be so exhausted."
"Hmph, it's not like your lifespan shortens because you're a bit tired, Dad."
"Well, that's true... what a reasonable answer."
"If you say anything more, I might just quit this dream power thing altogether."
"Oh, please don't do that."
Phyrops, rubbing his forehead, looked at the demons in the meeting room. The highest-ranking demons of the Hama system, including Shagal, were gathered.

"We will avoid direct combat with the Real Devil World as much as possible and only deploy troops to defend key positions. Station the masters in standby at each key point. Bianca and I will personally protect the headquarters."
"Understood."

"Again, don't bother to defend places that aren't major points. If the invasion of cracks is too intense in the medium and small cities, you can just completely give them up. Destroyed cities can be rebuilt. They won't dare to rampage unnecessarily since they also lack defense forces. They have no reason to invade other areas even beyond the influence of the crack."
The demons nodded.

"It's okay to lose some masters, but we must minimize casualties among the demons and beastmen forces. Weapons can be made as much as we want like rebuilding destroyed cities, but we can't bring back the dead. Not until our great work is accomplished."
"Sure!"
After a brief meeting, the demons left the conference room to carry out their orders.
Ainas did not leave her seat but stared at Pyrops intently.
"Daughter, it seems you have something to say. Are you trying to apologize for the verbal abuse you just gave me? How brave."
"What abuse did I give? That's not it, I just wanted to ask something."
"What is it?"
"Well, when our great task is completed. Can all the people who were sacrificed for the cause really come back?"
The great task, the resurrection of the Sun God Kinjelo.
Pyrops looked into his daughter's eyes.
"Not all of them. But perhaps many people will come back. Including your real mother. So, daughter, you must train your dream abilities more diligently from now on. So much depends on you."
Ainas shrugged her shoulders without responding.
Back to the ruined Groshi Castle.
An hour had passed since Hedo and Luna returned. The troops gathered at Groshi Castle showed no signs of returning to their own territories.
However, Jin had already received communications from spies hidden in the land of the anthropomorphs and the federation.
"According to the spies, Kinjelo and the Federation have exposed more of their resources. They both must think that this alone will be enough to fend off this rift."

Many superhumans who had been stationed at the battlefield of Groshi had returned to the territory of the Bamel Federation. Like with Ziffle, battles were also taking place in the federation's territory due to the transfer rift.
The overall war situation was not going badly. From the start, the Bamel Federation was the large force best prepared for the rift.
Now, the task of the Bamel Federation is to protect the Holy Kingdom.
Jin was waiting for a contact from the Holy Kingdom. As soon as Lani requested support via communication, he planned to go directly to the Holy Kingdom.
{Master Jin!}
Suddenly, the communicator vibrated. It was a contact from Kashimir.
"Knight Kashimir? What's the matter?"
{Thirty minutes ago, the Demon Realm began to attack the Holy Kingdom...!}
"You said thirty minutes ago?"
Jin's eyes widened.
The attack had started thirty minutes ago, but until now there had been no contact from the Holy Kingdom.

{They had a means to block communications! The only reason I was able to confirm that the Holy Kingdom was under attack, albeit late, was thanks to a Rainbow Bird informant who was standing by nearby. It seems you had to get quite a distance from the Holy Kingdom for communication to be possible. You should go to the Holy Kingdom right away.}
